diagnostic_definitions.geometry: degree and raw same-modality ego-to-neighbor cosine quartiles fit on training nodes only; cosine fit among nonisolated training nodes; apply thresholds to validation nodes; isolated bucket separate; small_n when n<100
diagnostic_definitions.homophily: only edges with both endpoints in train; excludes self-loops; uses train labels only
diagnostic_definitions.paired_correctness: 2x2 paired correctness counts on identical node IDs; accuracy deltas in [0,1] internally and pp in report
diagnostic_definitions.router: mean active path weights, argmax frequency, per-node entropy, validation degree-bin means, inactive-neighborhood mask violations
diagnostic_definitions.shuffle_perturbation: ten deterministic fixed router-context permutations for each trained J_NODE checkpoint; each val prediction reported separately; no logit ensemble

evaluation_schema.confusion_matrix: complete num_classes x num_classes; rows=true; columns=predicted; class order 0..C-1
evaluation_schema.macro_f1: derive TP/FP/FN from complete confusion row/column sums; average only fixed macro_f1_label_set
evaluation_schema.macro_f1_label_set_source: union of labels observed on official supervised train/val/test node indices; fixed before any test prediction and used identically for all models

selection_and_claim_limits: No test result selects an LR/model/design; no significance claim with three seeds; node weights and path counts are descriptive only.
